title: 第684章 胡布里斯的任务清单第683章 摇一摇
slug: 骑士先生魔王真的不存在啊
lines: 唐闻言一笑，看向了桑索菲亚摇来的众人；“可没有什么拖后腿一说，是我们借大家的力量，一起守护我们的家园。”
桑索菲亚这个唐崇拜狂热分子马上接话：“我知道！这是唐先生之前说的世界命运共同体！”
“总算等到我们发光发热的时候了！”
“我还以为我的一生都将碌碌无为，平安而平凡呢。”
姆莉瞥向群众，发现这些人就跟被洗脑了一样，全心全意，满脑子充斥着正义、世界和平之类的意志，让人看得莫名还有点感动。
接下来唐和桑索菲亚两个口才出色的人，领着半吊子的辛西娅就开始了动员演讲。
唐一段词，桑索菲亚一段词，辛西娅就在旁边当个助理。
动员结束，大家各司其职，先在精灵森林里搭建简易驻地。
小妖精们驾驶的护林傀儡最为显眼，仍旧吸引了不少人上前询问。
“妖精小朋友，你们这一身东西是什么呀？难道是马尔威王国的炼金武装铠甲？”一位教会圣骑士找上了小棕熊妖精。
“我们这是护林傀儡，我给我的这台取名熊霸天下号，还有，请叫我大熊。”名为大熊的小妖精在玻璃罩内激动地拍着胸口，护林傀儡也跟着做出了一样的动作。
“傀儡？头一次见到这样的傀儡，竟然让整个人坐在了内部。”圣骑士感到惊诧。
有一位穿着红色教会服饰的男子上前，伸出构造简陋的机械手臂，贪婪地打量着护林傀儡，那炽热的目光将大熊吓得连连后退。
“你要做什么呀？”大熊如此一退，也让其他妖精警惕起来，将唐也吸引了过来。
“别误会，我是世界教会的主教，也是炼金魔法师，看见如此精妙的炼金造物，情不自禁……”红衣主教快速解释。
“不过我觉得这种东西的确不应该叫做傀儡，形似铠甲，激光驱动，或许叫做机甲更为合适。”
唐忽然来了兴趣，在旁认真倾听。
红衣主教继续说：“我觉得未来战场应该被机甲统治，你能明白我的意思吗？驾驭这种重型炼金造物的人就是……”
“铁驭。”唐忽然插了一句话，吓到了红衣主教。
“啊、对，铁驭，驾驭大铁块的人，好名字！”回过神的红衣主教立即竖起了拇指。
圣骑士看主教的表现，尴尬得嘴角抽搐：“其实……我更好奇这东西是哪里来的？炼金技术进步的好快啊……”
“是胡布里斯的遗产喵~”妮蔻应声从人堆中探头。
“遗产？”圣骑士困惑，“胡布里斯应该还没死吧？”
妮蔻垂眸，表情多了几分冷意：“他会死的喵。”
“啊嚏！”
在另一边被妮蔻念叨着的胡布里斯用力打了个喷嚏。
在胡布里斯身旁的地洞里，蜜儿菲菈伸出了头，凝视着胡布里斯。
“如果你是因为温差感冒了，可以进我的巢穴，用你的话说，有地热。”
胡布里斯冷哼一声，露出了不屑的表情：“这是呼吸道黏膜受了刺激。”

Tang smiled when he heard the words and looked at the crowd that San Sophia had come to. "There is no holding back. We are borrowing everyone's strength to protect our home together."
Sansofia, a fanatic who worships Tang, immediately answered: "I know! This is the community of shared future for the world that Mr. Tang mentioned before!"
"It's finally time for us to shine!"
"I thought my whole life would be inactive, peaceful and ordinary."
Muli glanced at the crowd and found that these people seemed to have been brainwashed. They were wholehearted and full of wills such as justice and world peace. It was inexplicable and a little touching.
Next, Tang and Sansofia, two people with excellent eloquence, led the half-hearted Cynthia to start the mobilization speech.
Tang wrote a poem, Sansophia wrote a poem, and Cynthia was there as an assistant.
After the mobilization, everyone performed their duties and first set up a simple station in the Elf Forest.
The forest ranger puppet driven by the goblins was the most eye-catching, and it still attracted many people to come forward and ask.
"Little goblins, what are you wearing? Is it the alchemy armor from the Kingdom of Malvi?" A church paladin approached the little brown bear goblin.
"We are forest ranger puppets. I named mine Xiong Ba Tianxia, ​​and please call me Big Bear." The little goblin named Big Bear excitedly patted his chest in the glass cover, and the forest ranger puppet also followed suit.
"Puppet? It's the first time I've seen such a puppet. It actually made a person sit inside." The Paladin was surprised.
A man in red church clothes stepped forward, stretched out a crudely constructed mechanical arm, and looked at the forest ranger puppet greedily. His fiery gaze scared the big bear back.
"What are you going to do?" Big Bear's retreat also alerted the other goblins and attracted Tang.
"Don't get me wrong, I am the bishop of the World Church and an alchemical magician. I can't help myself when I see such exquisite alchemical creations..." the cardinal explained quickly.
"But I think this kind of thing shouldn't be called a puppet. It looks like an armor and is driven by a laser. Maybe it's more appropriate to call it a mecha."
Tang suddenly became interested and listened carefully.
The cardinal continued: "I think the future battlefield should be ruled by mechas. Can you understand what I mean? The person who controls this heavy alchemical creation is..."
"Pilot." Tang suddenly interjected, frightening the cardinal.
"Ah, yes, the driver, the person who controls the big iron block, what a name!" The cardinal who came back to his senses immediately gave a thumbs up.
Seeing the bishop's performance, the paladin's mouth twitched in embarrassment: "Actually... I'm more curious about where this thing came from? Alchemy technology has advanced so fast..."
"It's Hubris' legacy, meow~" Nico responded and poked her head out of the crowd.
"Legacy?" The Paladin was confused, "Hublis is not dead yet, right?"
Nicole lowered her eyes, her expression a little colder: "He will die, meow."
"Ah sneeze!"
Hubris, who was being talked about by Nico on the other side, sneezed hard.
In the hole next to Hubris, Milfila stretched out her head and stared at Hubris.
"If you catch a cold due to the temperature difference, you can enter my lair. In your words, there is geothermal heat."
Hubris snorted coldly and showed a disdainful expression: "This is because the respiratory mucosa is irritated."
